prompt: Which representations can model a many-to-many relationship such as follows between users?
explanation: The standard pattern is two sets per user — user:42:following and user:42:followers — giving O(1) writes and direct membership checks in both directions. A sorted set per relationship adds ordering by timestamp when recency matters, and a bitmap of dense integer ids is a compact special case. Concatenating all related ids into one string field destroys per-element access and forces O(N) rewrites.

options.text: One set per direction: user:42:following and user:42:followers
A sorted set per user scored by relationship timestamp, when recency ordering matters
One hash field holding every related id as a delimited string
A bitmap of user ids per relationship, when ids are dense integers
